fields.calculatedFormula:
IF(TODAY() -  Funding_Authorization__c >= 2 && ISNULL( PC_Conditions_Satisfied__c ), "PC Conditions; ", "" ) +
IF(TODAY() =  Funding_Date__c && ISNULL( Funding_Authorization__c )&& HOUR(TIMENOW() - 4) > 14  ||   TODAY() >  Funding_Date__c && ISNULL( Funding_Authorization__c ),  "Funding Authorization; ", "" ) +
IF(TODAY() >=  Business_Day_Before_Funding__c && ISNULL(  Funding_Wire_Requested__c  ), "Wire; ", "" ) +
IF( TODAY() - ( Funding_Date__c ) >= 1 && ISNULL(  Note_Received_Date__c ), "Note Received; ", "" ) +
IF(TODAY() >  Funding_Date__c && ISNULL( MERSUploadedActivated__c), "MERS Activation; ", "" ) +
IF(TODAY() >   Note_Received_Date__c && ISNULL(  Purchase_Advice_Date__c ), "Purchase Advice; ", "" ) +
IF(TODAY() >   Purchase_Advice_Date__c && ISNULL(   MERS_Transfer_to_Investor__c  ), "MERS Transfer; ", "" ) +
IF( TODAY() >=  Business_Day_Before_Funding__c&& ISNULL(  FedEx_Label_Sent__c ), "Send FedEx Label; ", "" ) +
IF( Business_Day_Before_Closing__c  <=  TODAY() && ISNULL(   MERS_Registration_Complete__c ), "MERS Registration; ", "" )

fields.calculatedFormula:
OR(
   AND(
       TODAY() -  Funding_Authorization__c >= 2,
       ISNULL( PC_Conditions_Satisfied__c )
       ),
   AND(
       OR(
          AND(
              TODAY() =  Funding_Date__c ,
              ISNULL(  Funding_Authorization__c ),
              HOUR(TIMENOW() - 4) > 14
             ),
          AND(
              TODAY() >  Funding_Date__c ,
              ISNULL( Funding_Authorization__c )
             )
         )
       ),
   
    AND(
        TODAY() >=  Business_Day_Before_Funding__c ,
        ISNULL(  Funding_Wire_Requested__c   )
       ),
    AND(
        TODAY()-  Funding_Date__c >= 2 ,
        ISNULL(  Note_Received_Date__c )
       ),
    AND(
        TODAY() >  Funding_Date__c ,
        ISNULL( MERS_Activated__c )
       ),
    AND(
        TODAY() >   Note_Received_Date__c ,
        ISNULL(  Purchase_Advice_Date__c )
       ),
    AND(
        TODAY() >=  Business_Day_Before_Funding__c ,
        ISNULL(   FedEx_Label_Sent__c )
       ),
    AND(
        TODAY() >   Purchase_Advice_Date__c ,
        ISNULL(   MERS_Transfer_to_Investor__c  )
       )
  )

fields.name: Action_Required__c

fields.calculatedFormula:
AND(
    NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Closed')),
    NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Cancelled')),
    NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Post-Closed')),
    NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Lost')),
OR(
   AND(
       TODAY() >=  Two_Days_Before_Closing__c ,
       ISNULL( Closing_Package_Sent__c )
      ),
   ISPICKVAL(  Closing_Package_Status__c , "Rejected"),
   TODAY() = Closing_Package_Sent__c && ISPICKVAL(  Closing_Package_Status__c , "") && HOUR(TIMENOW() - 4) > 14,
   TODAY() >  Closing_Package_Sent__c  && ISPICKVAL(  Closing_Package_Status__c , "")
)
)
